name: Aholiab
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: With him the Lord gave Aholiab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, and put wisdom in the hearts of all that were wise hearted, that they might make all that he had commanded.

note.label: Exodus 31: Bezaleel and Aholiab, and the Sabbath Sign

points: He hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he and Aholiab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; the two brothers the Most High was dealing with in workmanship trained and taught their fellow brethren how to do it.

note.label: Exodus 35: The Sabbath and the Willing Hearted Offering

points: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab and every wise hearted man in whom the Lord put wisdom and understanding, according to all that the Lord had commanded; they were over the cunning work of the building and were leading the men among them in how the work was done.

note.label: Exodus 36: The Wise Hearted Build the Tabernacle
